user.title: Oil Monitor
user.description: Choose your tank, temperature, runtime, and weather entities. A personalized forecast needs at least 14 complete, clean weeks of daily long-term statistics.

data.stale_after_minutes: Mark the tank reading stale after (minutes)

data_description.depth_entity: Select the sensor reporting distance in centimetres from the ultrasonic sensor to the oil surface.
data_description.timestamp_entity: Select the sensor containing the time the ultrasonic measurement was actually taken, not the MQTT last-updated time.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Select a temperature sensor with long-term statistics in °C or °F.
data_description.indoor_entity: Select a room or thermostat temperature sensor with long-term statistics.
data_description.runtime_entity: Select a sensor that reports daily heating runtime, preferably with long-term statistics.
data_description.indoor_target_entity: Select the thermostat target temperature. Its current value is used for the forecast.
data_description.weather_entity: Select a weather entity that provides seven daily forecasts.
data_description.tank_capacity: The first version uses the supplied depth-to-level calibration table and scales it to this capacity.
data_description.stale_after_minutes: Your sensor normally reports about every 35 minutes. The default allows for missed reports.
